identity.name: Prajwal
identity.role: Final Year B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering Student
identity.professional_summary: Final year B.Tech CSE student with hands-on experience building production-ready full-stack applications and multi-agent AI platforms using Next.js, MERN, PERN, and Node.js microservices. Built and shipped multiple full-stack and AI projects involving authentication, real-time systems, payments, microservices, RAG, and generative AI.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering

responsibilities: Architected and shipped CortexAI as the core internship project — a multi-agent AI SaaS platform with 8 specialized agents.
Orchestrated specialized agents as LangGraph flows via LangChain and routed requests across multiple LLM providers including Groq, DeepSeek, and Gemini.
Designed a Node.js microservices architecture consisting of Auth, Chat, Agent, and Billing services behind a single API Gateway.
Used Upstash Redis for session caching, per-conversation memory, and per-agent rate limiting.
Built a RAG pipeline using document chunking, embeddings, and Qdrant vector search for grounded document Q&A.
Implemented credit-based billing with Razorpay and Firebase Authentication verified server-side.
Built a React/Redux frontend with a Monaco-powered coding artifact panel and live preview.
Built and maintained production features across the MERN stack.
Worked on front-end development using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and React.js.
Worked on back-end development using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs integrated with MongoDB.
Used Git for version control and Jira for project management and sprint tracking.

As part of extended internship training, architected and shipped a full-featured YouTube-style streaming platform clone with authentication, content management, AI-powered search, and creator studio analytics.
